subject: Parallel process latent growth curve structural SEM

messages.author: 83672154857b8124
messages.subject: Parallel process latent growth curve structural SEM
parts:
Dear users,

I am trying to fit a growth curve model with structural equation models using lavaan. Although I erased all the observations with missing values in any covariate, I still keep seeing this message:

Error in lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset: cor9
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In names(out)[1L] <- NAME :
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length
2: In names(out)[1L] <- NAME :
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

Does anybody have any ideas why I keep seeing it despite I erased all the missing data?

Best wishes,

Carlos

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Parallel process latent growth curve structural SEM
parts:
Carlos

This is not related to missing data in a variable. It is saying that lavaan cannot find the variable name cor9, lavaan is seing a variable cor9 in your syntax model but cannot find that in your data

Check your data set, and that you are not misspeling something in the lavaan model. Remeber R is case sensitive too

bye
